question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND cs.points > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
min_constructors AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.year,
        cp.constructor_id,
        cp.total_points
    FROM constructor_points cp
    JOIN min_points_per_year mpp ON cp.year = mpp.year AND cp.total_points = mpp.min_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        constructor_id,
        COUNT(*) as seasons_count
    FROM min_constructors
    GROUP BY constructor_id
)
SELECT 
    cc.constructor_id,
    c.name,
    cc.seasons_count
FROM constructor_counts cc
JOIN constructors c ON cc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cc.seasons_count DESC
LIMIT 5
